column2: CIRISAgent#990 — prompt-YAML keys that never reached a model.
Method: replace one key's value with a unique marker via the research
dma_prompt override namespace, re-compose all DMA steps across 29 locales
(1740 baseline blocks, 14 DMA steps), count composed blocks whose bytes moved.
blocks_moved = 0 means the key is not composed by the template that owns it.
CONTROLS ARE LOAD-BEARING. A negative result from a marker probe is worthless
on its own: "0 blocks moved" and "the harness silently did nothing" are the
same observation. The control rows below are live sibling keys run through
the IDENTICAL path in the SAME sweep. They move. That is what licenses reading
a 0 as deadness rather than as instrument failure — and it is not hypothetical
caution: an early full-locale sweep returned 0 for every key including the
controls, because a research manifest makes the conscience steps refuse an
English fallback for 'am'. The controls caught that. Without them the sweep
would have reported every key dead.
verdict:  DEAD = composed nowhere | LIVE = composes as expected
